steps.content: You traverse the ruined city. In the thick fog, your mind gradually blurs as if you're falling asleep. You're dissolving amid the indistinct voices, unable to recall the reason why you're here.
But the spark is right next to you. You can barely hear someone's voice in your ear.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: You're scared to be with me... Every time we get close, you'll pull away... You're afraid to face me, I know...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Why? You don't hate me, so why? What are you really afraid of?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Maybe. Maybe I really am afraid. I'm worried you'll end up like them. I'm scared to watch it tear you to pieces again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But if it's just venturing alone by myself, I can bear it... I'm a grown-up now. I won't be a coward again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's why I have to come back... I've had enough...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm tired of falling into traps over and over again, tired of it using you guys to torture me. I tell myself to "stay rational and don't fall into traps", and it makes me sick every time I say it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What really happened back then... What's the thing that destroyed you all and came back to haunt me... I've gotten so close this time. That's why I'm here. I must see the truth and identify my true enemy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can't be fooled by it anymore.
Your consciousness blurs further. Whispers from the surrounding shadows turn into vague noise. Only the blood-red moonlight remains in sight.
Fooled? Heh heh heh... No...
A voice objects, but it sounds comfortingly familiar.
No... This is not a trap. No one has lured you here... Everything happened because your heart desired a response...

And you are destined to return... Even if you know the journey is perilous, even if you want to personally escort that girl out, even if... Heh, no, from the moment you entered the dream, you've been destined to come...
It's not about courage or cowardice, or those trivial missions...
Poor child, you're just too sad, too lonely... You simply miss home, so sooner or later, you must come home...
An obscure figure appears in your mind.
...Me? Miss home?
Yes... Every time you fall into a nightmare, every time you return to the Illusory Moon, you're brought here by your own longing...
You miss home, so you come back... You miss your family, so you meet them...
Meet who?
The ruins of the city are behind you. Your legs move on their own and you walk on the desolate, gray shallows alone.
No, you're not alone. Human-like specters hover around you. You gaze at them blankly, trying to make out their faces, which are unrecognizable yet familiar.
They seem to want to say something to you, or are just muttering to themselves.

steps.speaker: Blurry Shadow
steps.content: It's down here. Now we're sure... It's at the bottom... We must... continue... We can't stop diving...

steps.speaker: Blurry Shadow
steps.content: We've found it... ██... after so much... sacrifice... Giving up at this moment... is not an option...
The voice sounds familiar yet incoherent. The person seems to be crying.

steps.speaker: Blurry Shadow
steps.content: Still... holding on... even if we'll no longer be... what we were... but...
You want to touch that shadow, but she disappears into the mist in the blink of an eye and is nowhere to be found.

steps.speaker: Inquisitive Shadow
steps.content: Wait, tell me more about the meaning of your language. What you saw beyond the boundary on the other side...

steps.speaker: Inquisitive Shadow
steps.content: I believe in your wisdom. I think you've returned to this side of the shore because you have a message to convey...

steps.speaker: Inquisitive Shadow
steps.content: So... give me the prophecy and the revelation.
The shadow poses the question loud and clear into the mist, but fails to get the desired response, instead descending into chaos and merging into it.

steps.speaker: Troubled Shadow
steps.content: No, I see no pattern... The model is proven wrong again. All the calculations have gone to waste...

steps.speaker: Troubled Shadow
steps.content: This makes no sense. Is there an error in the data...? Yes, that must be it. Something went wrong during the collection in the dive. That has to be it...

steps.speaker: Troubled Shadow
steps.content: If not... What's the point... of everything we've done?
Muttering hysterically, the shadow stands frozen, clutching its head in agony.
The next moment, with a pop, she explodes like a balloon, blending in with the mist around her.

steps.speaker: Quarreling Shadow
steps.content: Why are you looking at me like that? Can't the great scholar understand the idea of power? Or is it humanity you can't grasp? No... You all must know...

steps.speaker: Quarreling Shadow
steps.content: We've come so far together, yet you've never trusted me... What else is there to say?
An agonized screech. The shadows overlap, mauling and obliterating each other.
You simply watch them. The voices and feelings are so familiar, as if... you're always meant to be here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My... family...
Yes, your family. You're finally getting closer... by their side, at last. Are you satisfied now?
Joy dispels the pain and despair. Among the shadows of these revenants, you feel at peace.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Yes.
Haha... No, too soon...
There is one more of them. The real reason you came here. It's neither rational nor emotional, neither about fear nor determination...
It's because you've finally heard its call... finally grown up and waited till this day...
So, go on...

The figures all stand up and raise their hands. Slowly, you look toward the direction they're pointing at and step forward, feeling a warmth you've never felt before. Blue light flashes, and is shattered in an instant by red light.

You cross the shallows and walk toward the deep sea. The surface of the sea begins to boil. Something rises from the abyss. In the sky, rings of light ripple outward, the concentric circles surrounding the central red moon.

Moonlight reflects off the water, paving a red path of light. Gladly, you move forward, your consciousness gradually dissolving into the deep sea, in a blissful embrace where all imperfections and insignificance are accepted.
Go... Meet... your real family...
You walk toward the splendor at the end of the light path, like an infant returning to the womb.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: The readings were stable until a moment ago. Can the FAC verify the cause of the sudden change?
<color=#fb9259>??-06</color>: No, the wave charts are a mess. But the frontline squads have entered the mutated area and are doing their best to stop the Mania.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: I see... Schorl is retrying the revival protocol. Use as many Hypercubes as needed. Do whatever necessary to bring him back.
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: There's only a 15-minute window. After that, disposal will be mandatory.
<color=#fb9259>??-06</color>: ?!
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: I see... Schorl is retrying the revival protocol. Use as many Hypercubes as needed. Do whatever necessary to bring her back.
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: There's only a 15-minute window. After that, disposal will be mandatory.
<color=#fb9259>??-06</color>: ?!

steps.content: <color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: This is different from previous instances. If No. 13 breaks down now, it will be a real catastrophe.

Inside the shield room, the shackles' red light pierces through the devices, canceling out the Hypercube energy. Amid the intense clash of red and blue light, ${PlayerName}'s face is almost contorted and the body is twisted into an extremely painful posture.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...Order received. The first and third Observatoriums have joined the operation and are currently recording and analyzing the data.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Target one, the search for SHP-13 is still ongoing. We've encountered significant obstacles.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Target two, the phenomenon's singularity coordinates are confirmed. It has made a move.
The girl jerks her body up, but the irrepressible fear turns into a fearful shudder, almost crushing her body.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: <size=44>That idiot!!!</size>
